Although average regret remains small (mean_delta_vs_best_fixed about 0.00408, median_delta_vs_best_fixed 0, mean_delta_vs_fixed_partial about -0.00255, mean_delta_vs_independent about -0.00403), replication-level failure risk is not rare: both selector variants have loss_rate about 0.422, negative_failure_rate about 0.356, and high_positive_loss_rate about 0.428, with worst-cell delta_vs_best_fixed about 0.0832. Therefore e009 can only support a mean-level condition-specific selector observation, not a seed/threshold-stable deployable Stage 1 rule. D011 is superseded for deployment-strength claims.
